notes.title: New Steam Goodies Unlocked!
notes.content:
Hey Steam community,

We've got some great news, all thanks to your awesome activity! We've unlocked cool stuff for you. You can now get beautiful profile backgrounds, collectible cards, fun emoticons, and cool icons.

Personalize your Steam experience and have fun with these new items. Thanks for being part of this community – more fun updates are on the way! 🎮🌟
